title: SpecCompact: Accelerating LLM Agent Context Compaction with Slot-Parallel Semantic Speculative Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.06876v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents use context compaction to manage growing interaction histories, but summarizing long histories with large models can introduce substantial delays. Compaction therefore requires balancing information retention against latency. We observe that structured summary slots can retain information when generated independently. Based on this observation, we present SpecCompact, a framework that accelerates compaction through slot-parallel semantic speculation. SpecCompact fine-tunes a small drafter and generates slots in parallel. The target model verifies each proposed line and repairs rejected content, while subsequent drafting uses the updated slot prefix. System optimizations further reduce repeated context processing and model calls. Across AppWorld and $\tau^3$ benchmarks with two target models, SpecCompact achieves $2.04$--$5.63\times$ compaction speedups over Hermes-style summarization. translated_title: SpecCompact：通过槽并行语义投机验证加速LLM智能体上下文压缩
translated_abstract: LLM智能体使用上下文压缩来管理不断增长的交互历史，但使用大模型对长历史进行摘要会引入显著的延迟。因此，压缩需要在信息保留与延迟之间取得平衡。我们观察到，结构化摘要槽在独立生成时能够保留信息。基于这一观察，我们提出了SpecCompact，一个通过槽并行语义投机来加速压缩的框架。SpecCompact微调一个小型起草模型并并行生成各个槽，目标模型验证每条提议的内容并修复被拒绝的内容，同时后续起草使用更新后的槽前缀。系统优化进一步减少了重复的上下文处理和模型调用。在AppWorld和$\tau^3$两个基准测试以及两个目标模型上，SpecCompact相比Hermes风格的摘要方法实现了2.04至5.63倍的压缩加速。单独的下游评估揭示了模（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: SpecCompact通过小型起草模型并行生成结构化摘要槽、由目标模型进行语义验证与修复的投机框架，将LLM智能体上下文压缩速度提升2.04至5.63倍。
